title: test_chart_survey rides the testing database, leaving live counts unchanged
intention: test_chart_survey.py rides the testing database: under the test runner every row it writes goes to cairn_testing (e4fd7f28faaf), never to the live tables, so a run leaves the live cairn_nodes, cairn_embeddings and cairn_links counts unchanged and two copies at once do not collide. The proof carries no run id, no testing marker and no clean-up of its own.
why: Measured 2026-11-20: 316 nodes and 316 embeddings from this proof's runs stand in the live cairn_nodes and cairn_embeddings, none marked as testing, because its scratch nexus drops only the leaf table. Proof rows in the live corpus are indistinguishable from real ones to every reader of the trees.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: a proof's rows in the live corpus are measurements of nothing, read as real); Law 9 (green is earned: a proof that leaves residue is not clean green).
how: Rides e4fd7f28faaf: once a test run's writes reach cairn_testing by construction (outline 4.3.1.5.1.5.2, the runner sets the context, never the proof), cairn/devices/codemother/machines/survey/proofs/test_chart_survey.py needs no mark-and-clean code, and this ticket writes none. Its build is the red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/survey/proofs/test_chart_survey_runs_alongside_itself.py: it runs two copies of test_chart_survey.py at once and reads the live cairn_nodes, cairn_embeddings and cairn_links counts before and after. It is red today (the rows land in live) and turns green when e4fd7f28faaf lands, with no change to test_chart_survey.py. If it stays red after e4fd7f28faaf, what remains is this ticket's finding. RULE 1: it measures only codemother's own proof.

decisions.text: D1: no change to test_chart_survey.py: no run id, no testing marker, no finally-block cleanup. The isolation is e4fd7f28faaf's, by construction.
D2: the red-first proof runs two copies at once and counts rows before and after, one tooth per clause.
